name: Heartbeat ~ Painting your heart
source:
Julia dreamed of being a painter and was tired of the monochrome of her life.
Who would say her world was going to get a lot of colors all of a sudden?
A cute love story will begin.
translation:
朱莉娅梦想成为画家，早已厌倦了单调无色的生活。
谁能想到，她的世界竟会突然变得如此缤纷？
一段可爱的爱情故事即将开始。
